summary: Corrected proposal ready: ADR not required because no architecture decision; requirements required because the change affects external workflow behavior. Added testable requirements and scenarios for design testing strategy, concrete plan validations, at-least-one E2E validation, and existing-tool/user-approved pivots.
Requirements auditor PASS captured; requirements define externally testable workflow behavior and ADR triggers for testing-toolchain changes.

Design updated to require requirement/scenario test coverage: plans must map every topic-generated REQ-* and SCN-* to validation items or explicit justified non-test/manual evidence exceptions. Design validators/auditors must check this coverage before approval. Topic validation passed via design.V8.
Plan updated with requirement/scenario coverage matrix and revalidated; plan auditor PASS recorded after coverage review. Awaiting human approval before implementation.

P0 approval/baseline: user approved design and plan; repository baseline contains expected planning/lifecycle artifacts only; package.json test command inventory reviewed; proposal ADR metadata preserved (adr_required=false for this proposal, future major testing-toolchain changes trigger ADR evaluation). P0.V1 and P0.V2 passed.

P1 design skill strategy contract complete: skills/design/SKILL.md now requires behavior-changing topics to include a project-specific Testing Strategy with language/app type, existing tools/scripts, related ADRs, source-backed docs, unit/integration/E2E strategy, named E2E validation, requirement/scenario coverage expectation, and escalation to researcher/archivist, cartographer-compass, or interview. Workflow docs tests and skill-language check passed.

P2 plan skill validation contract complete: skills/plan/SKILL.md now consumes accepted design Testing Strategy, requires Testing Strategy Trace metadata, concrete artifacts/scenarios/commands, requirement/scenario coverage matrix or justified exceptions, at-least-one E2E validation, generic-only rejection, and ADR-trigger handling for major testing-toolchain pivots. Workflow docs tests and skill-language check passed.

P3 deterministic validator checks complete after auditor-requested tightening: validate_planning_graph.py enforces Testing Strategy presence and required fields, plan trace/coverage matrix, REQ/SCN coverage tied to validation IDs or explicit evidence exceptions, E2E presence, non-concrete/generic validation rejection, and ADR-trigger detection. Temp-root tests cover missing strategy, missing fields, uncovered requirements/scenarios, missing E2E, non-concrete validation, generic-only validation, and ADR-trigger failure. Focused validator tests, real topic validation, and check:scripts passed.

P4 auditor/handoff guidance complete after auditor correction: cartographer-auditor checks strategy evidence, existing tools/ADRs, unit/integration/E2E, requirement coverage, concrete gates, and generic-only rejection. Design and plan skill handoffs now require strategy/trace evidence, requirement coverage summary, context-pack ID, deterministic receipt IDs, unresolved-decision notes, and receipt output path. Workflow docs tests and grep static inspection passed.

P5 E2E workflow validation complete: added temp-root synthetic topic test test_testing_strategy_valid_topic_passes that exercises manage_jsonl.ts validate-topic and validate_planning_graph.py under /tmp with requirements, design Testing Strategy, plan validation trace, facts, and map records. Focused Python tests, targeted E2E smoke, npm run test:py, npm run test:ts after npm ci and dashboard:build, and check:scripts passed.

P6 finalization complete: requirements folded into docs/requirements.md; final auditor PASS recorded; topic JSONL, planning graph, and npm run check passed. ADR evaluation confirmed no ADR for this workflow-policy proposal while preserving future testing-toolchain ADR triggers. Residual warnings are non-blocking: candidate-only map warnings, Vite chunk-size warning, Shiki WASM fallback, dashboard expected stderr, and Python sqlite ResourceWarning.

Implementation complete: all P0-P6 phases complete; requirements folded; final topic/planning validation and npm run check passed; final auditor PASS recorded; ADR not required for this proposal with future testing-toolchain ADR triggers preserved.
